messages:
Terri: quick thread 1 - NimbusWorks case study ready for final pass. need: one approved quote, two social cards, publish + webinar CTA. target publish next Wed 9am PT. who can take lead?

Owen: I got ops. I'll schedule the customer sign-off call and set CMS draft. interview was yesterday, transcript in drive.

Rina: I'll polish the hero and pull a short quote. flagging that Nimbus asked we not call out exact internal model names.

Sam: Sales routing note 1 - want webinar registrants tagged as "nimbus_webinar" and case readers as "nimbus_case". Hook AE webhook to #ae-notify.

Terri: good. GrowthBot: please create UTM template and test lead flow.

GrowthBot: UTM template created: ?utm_source=marketing&utm_campaign=nimbus_case&utm_medium=post. Test lead created and delivered to AE queue.

Owen: CMS draft ready at <https://cms.redwood/drafts/nimbus-1776>. assets in folder: <https://drive.redwood/content/nimbus-assets>. scheduled publish slot Wed 09:00 PT pending legal signoff.

Rina: draft hero line: "NimbusWorks reduced inference p95 by 3x and cut serving spend by ~30% after switching to Redwood." working on a tighter customer quote.

Terri: pinging legal early. Courtney, can you run the quote through LegalBot? Need confirmation on name usage + metrics phrasing by EOD Mon.

LegalBot: received submission. Please use approval form: <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=nimbus-1776>. Typical turnaround 24-48h.

Sam: SalesOps: I've set mapping for HubSpot: lead source = nimbus_case; webinar tag = nimbus_webinar; AE webhook active. Also added a Slack alert that posts a snippet of the lead.

Rina: draft quote for review: "Redwood helped us slash p95 latency and reduce serving costs, enabling faster feature rollout without ballooning infrastructure spend."

Terri: tweak to concrete numbers? Lean legal-friendly: reference percentages but avoid competitor mentions. Owen, do we have final metrics?

Owen: metrics sheet: p95 improved from 420ms -> 130ms (~3.2x) and steady-state cost down 29%. source: <https://docs.redwood/internal/nimbus-metrics-1776>.

Rina: updated quote: "Redwood reduced our p95 latency by ~3x and lowered serving costs by 29%, which let us ship new features faster." submitting to LegalBot now.

LegalBot: quote received. Running checks for customer consent and benchmarking language. ETA 24h. Please confirm customer name usage permission uploaded.

Terri: customer permission uploaded to the form. also marked the customer contact for final signoff call on Tue 11am PT.

LegalBot: approval ready with minor edit 1 replaced "our" with company name per style guide; removed the word "slash" in any alternate copy. Approved doc at: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/nimbus-1776/approved.pdf>.

Owen: nice. CMS draft updated with approved quote. social card images finalized and uploaded.

Sam: smoke test on HubSpot flow successful. sample webinar signup created with UTM params and routed to AE queue. Slack alert posted properly.

Terri: OK to flip publish at Wed 9am. Ashley in comms will handle scheduled social blasts. I'll add CTA to register for Apr 21 webinar in the blog and social.

Rina: final copy pushed to CMS. meta tags, OG image, and two social captions set.

GrowthBot: final lead routing check complete. AE queue health = good. webhook latency <200ms on test events.

Terri: thanks everyone. locking timeline. I'll post announce note in #all-hands after publish. Closing loop after live. :rocket:
